'''Volume 38: The Other Side of This World''' is the 38th volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, the ninth and final volume in the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}} and the first for the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume nine of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
''Finally together again, Dia, Pearl, and Platinum must battle Legendary Pokémon Dialga and Palkia, who are being controlled by Cyrus, the powerful boss of Team Galactic! Then a new Legendary Pokémon leaps into the fray! Whose side is it on...?''

''And who will rescue Platinum’s hapless bodyguards from the mysterious Distortion World they’ve been banished to...?''

''Plus, hang with Lopunny and meet Porygon-Z, Gallade, and... Looker?!''

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* [[Sird]] explains her involvement in the events of the current and [[Emerald chapter (Adventures)|the previous]] chapter.
* {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} defeat [[Cyrus]].
* [[Distortion World|A mysterious black hole]] appears over [[Spear Pillar]]. {{p|Giratina|Tentacles}} emerge, taking Cyrus, {{p|Dialga}}, and {{p|Palkia}} with them into the hole.
* Platinum arrives at the [[Battle Zone]] and meets {{adv|Looker}}.
* [[Buck]] ventures into [[Stark Mountain]] and finds the [[Magma Stone]].
